text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's El Condor! It's El Condor! El Condor 
Pasaaaar!!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
No doubts at 2,400 meters! Here flies the 
monstrous bird taking off toward the 
world!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaaan, I did iiit, yeeeeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El is, El has finally, at long last, with 
bated breath—!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the Japan Cuuuup is...!! 
BUENAAAA!!!!

I lift up the hugged El Condor Pasa. 
Carrying her like an airplane toward the 
winner's circle.

Her body soaring through the air seemed 
smaller than expected, yet simultaneously, 
immensely grand.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyooone, DEATH!! A late 
bloomer reclaiming her honor and 
fulfilling her long-cherished wish—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As you all know, El Condor Pasa!! Has put 
the world stage in checkmate!!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

"Amid the resounding cheers of 
celebration... everyone's gazes suddenly 
converged in a single direction."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El-chan...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan...?

The unsung hero of the Japan Cup. Special 
Week.

Without her growth and that fighting 
spirit in her final push, this race 
wouldn't have been nearly as thrilling.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Spe-chan, the greatest amiga worthy 
of praise!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Today is bueno, truly bueno! And... you 
have something you want to tell El, no?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that praise for victory falling 
from those lips? Or perhaps... resentment?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if you end up hating me, it's love! 
Spe-chan, I love you! Please say whatever 
you feel!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I want you to strike El with your true 
feelings, stripped bare to the waist! Come 
on, Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-O-Oh...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
O...? Congratulations? Just you remember 
this?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "S-E-C-O-N-D-S!"

The entire venue tilted their heads in 
unison along with El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because I had so much fun today! And 
because I want to run with El-chan even 
more!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"So I want 'seconds'! I'm running in the 
Arima Kinen too!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: O-O-Oh...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Did you all hear that!? That roar just 
now! That resounding declaration!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Our very own Spe-chan is coming to the 
"Arima Kinen" too, yeeeeees!!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, let's do this! The three of 
us—you, Grass, and me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is no longer a title 
match, it's now a battle royaaaal!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Yeah!!

The whirlwind of battle sweeps Special 
Week up with it, growing even larger.

And so, the Arima Kinen turned into a 
dream-like, free-for-all brawl bringing 
three close friends together.
